Name: Custom Backpack Framework for Yuzu Chest
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
Custom Backpack Framework for Yuzu Chest is a compatibility build of Custom Backpack Framework.
It fixes inventory layout and scrolling issues when using large backpacks with vanilla chests and Yuzu Chest.
Yuzu Chest and vanilla chests as well! You can choose 48, 60, 72... all the way up to 1,008 slots!


[color=#00ffff][size=4][b][i]Features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
• Supports vanilla chests and Yuzu Chest
• Keeps the current backpack row after transferring an item
• Keeps the current backpack row when switching between chests with Chests Anywhere
• Compatible with Automate, Chests Anywhere, and Better Sort
• Supports Pack and Backpack Collection and other Custom Backpack Framework content packs


[b][color=#00ffff][size=4][i]Important[/i][/size][/color][/b]
Do not install this together with the original Custom Backpack Framework. This mod replaces it and uses the same Unique ID so existing backpack content packs will continue to work.
Other custom or oversized chest menus are not officially supported.
